outcome: Predictive accuracy of metabolite biomarkers for GDM
cohort: 118 pregnant women (59 with gestational diabetes mellitus and 59 without GDM) in their third trimester.
finding: 27 differential metabolites were identified between GDM and control groups, and a combination of five metabolite biomarkers (L-valine, hypoxanthine, eicosapentaenoic acid, 2-amino-1,3,4-octadecanotriol, and choline) showed an AUC of 0.769 for GDM detection.
